subject: the Compressor Peak/RMS Controls row through the verified read-only parameter path
question: On the protected fixture, does the exact product candidate read the named Peak/RMS one-hot pair, preserve its boolean and display meaning, restore the prior plug-in view and close its newly opened editor without calling a setter?

reverify.expected: exits 0 and writes a receipt whose checks are all true: State A returns a boolean raw value and the matching Peak/RMS display with write_attempted false, view restoration and new-editor close are observed, before and after inventories identify the same target, and stdin close removes the server process
reverify.cost: about ten seconds on the protected fixture with stopped playback

method: Built debug product LogicProMCP from product candidate 79f0229c084c12b3cbe94ddc1bf7b8ec79346de0 (tree db3ad991bf25bd7d57bde84860165788bf53eecd; binary SHA-256 38d99aba5b890e25631c798aaa78499b17130647f0771a5694d60a3d5afcc447). Native UI automation first identified the exact Logic Pro app and protected project, one standard window, stopped playback and recording, Audio 13 selected, the Mixer visible, and no open menu or plug-in editor. The bounded stdio sequence refreshed cache, bound the current project, issued the exact Compressor insert reference, read rms_mode, repeated the inventory, and stopped the server by closing stdin. Independent UI readback afterward again found the same sole project window with no menu or plug-in editor. No parameter setter, save, project close, key input or direct UI click was used by the qualification controller.

observations.what: independent native UI readback after the server stopped

conclusion: The exact product candidate read the named Peak/RMS pair as boolean true and display RMS in State A, called no setter, observed view restoration and new-editor close, retained the same complete target inventory, and left only the protected project window with no open menu.
limits: One protected fixture, one Compressor instance, one host, and ko-KR only.

The native receipt observed the RMS-selected state. Focused tests cover both Peak and RMS plus both/neither selected, wrong title, duplicate, unreadable and drifting evidence, but those test fixtures are not additional native observations.
This read-only observation establishes neither Peak/RMS actuation nor write support, inverse behavior, idempotency, cross-model availability, or a physical-unit mapping.
The measured binary was built from product source at candidate 79f0229c084c12b3cbe94ddc1bf7b8ec79346de0. The later harness and receipt commit changes no product or test source under measurement.
This extends the read-only C1 workflow; it does not satisfy #299's C2 physical-unit write, C3 snapshot/compensation, C4 recommendation/application, or full Compressor closure.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record measures runtime AX values, one-hot selection, lifecycle receipts and window cleanup. It does not claim that a quoted label is shipped in Apple's canonical string corpus.
